defect_found_and_fixed_this_phase.description: rv_grep_blocking's non-markdown branch (added Phase 2) always returned exit 0 (sort's own exit status), regardless of whether any line matched, silently breaking the grep-compatible 0=found/1=not-found contract for any future DIRECT caller checking $? on this function (callers piping through 'grep -q .', as every existing test helper and the probe script do, were unaffected since they read the FOUND signal from output content, not this function's exit code).
defect_found_and_fixed_this_phase.caught_by: A sanity check on record-version-exemptions.md during Phase 4 marker verification returned rc=0 with empty output -- a contradiction that would not occur under grep's own exit-status contract.
defect_found_and_fixed_this_phase.fix: rv_grep_blocking's non-markdown branch now captures the merged/sorted result and explicitly returns 0 only when it is non-empty, 1 otherwise, instead of letting sort's own exit code leak through.
defect_found_and_fixed_this_phase.regression_coverage_added: Two new assertions in test-record-version-patterns.sh directly check rv_grep_blocking's own exit status (not just piped output) on a non-markdown path with and without a real finding.

important_tooling_caveat_found_this_phas.description: Ad hoc 'source lib; grep ...' debugging run directly in this dispatch's own interactive Bash-tool shell silently used a shadowing grep shell function (a ugrep -G compatibility layer) rather than real GNU grep, and ugrep gave WRONG (false-negative) verdicts for this library's \b...\b.{0,80}\b...\b proximity patterns -- exactly the caveat the library's own header already warns about ('the actual runtime engine is always GNU grep, not the ugrep shell-function substitution ... never pasted into an agent's own top-level Bash-tool shell').
important_tooling_caveat_found_this_phas.impact: None on load-bearing results: the fixture suite and both corpus probes were always run via 'bash scriptfile.sh' (a genuine subprocess that does not inherit the interactive shell's grep function), so all reported pass/fail and residue counts in this and prior phases' progress files are correct. Only my own supplementary ad hoc verification commands were affected, and were discarded/re-run via subprocess once the discrepancy surfaced.
important_tooling_caveat_found_this_phas.recorded_via: issue-record.sh, class 'test infrastructure', this phase and Phase 2
